summary: Iteration 15 — Full regression on the new Topic→Variable Mapping feature (admin). Backend: 8 pytest tests on /api/admin/topic-mappings covering list (sorted asc by topic), create, duplicate rejection (400), viewer forbidden (403), PATCH toggle + target_var change, DELETE (and re-delete 404), end-to-end routing verification (sniff /A100 shows events with var=TEMPERATURA and mapped_from=/A100/TEMPERATURA within 60s), and CJ031/A100 fancoil online with temperature set from mapped topic. 8/8 passed. Frontend: logged in with felipejferreira@gmail.com/@Pilares1, opened Admin → Diagnóstico MQTT. Verified all four data-testids on the mapping form (mapping-topic-input, mapping-did-select, mapping-var-select, mapping-add-button). Fancoil select is populated by the active-fancoil list (15 options). Created a unique mapping /TESTE_UI_RETEST15/HELLO → CE94 TEMPERATURA via UI (toast 'Mapeamento criado' shown, row appeared in mappings-table). Toggled enabled off (data-state checked→unchecked) and then deleted the row (toast 'Mapeamento removido', row gone, 2 preexisting rows preserved). Confirmed the 'Mapear' prefill button in a /SISTEMA/… row (data-testid map-prefill-0) fills mapping-topic-input with the raw topic ('/SISTEMA/LED') and scrolls to the form. The existing production mappings (/A100/TEMPERATURA, /A100/VAG) remain in the table with enabled=true. Routing path is working end-to-end: A100 ESP32 publishing /A100/TEMPERATURA and /A100/VAG without the TJS prefix is correctly reinterpreted as device A100 TEMPERATURA/VAG and the fancoil CJ031 is online with temperature=22.1°C and VAG=90.2 visible in sniff.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py uses `req.dict(exclude_unset=True)` on PATCH — Pydantic v2 deprecates .dict() in favor of .model_dump(). Works but will warn.
The duplicate check in create_topic_mapping is case-sensitive and whitespace-trimmed only on topic (not target_device_id). This is fine but worth documenting.
No unique index on db.topic_mappings.topic — concurrent POSTs can race past the duplicate check. Consider adding an index: topic unique.

reload_mappings() only loads enabled!=False entries into the service's in-memory dict. This is correct behavior and matches the toggle semantics — disabling via PATCH removes it from routing after reload.
seed_data_creation: Test created and cleaned up: topic mapping /TESTE_RETEST15/XYZ (CRUD) and /TESTE_UI_RETEST15/HELLO (UI); viewer user TEST_viewer_iter15@example.com was created for 403 testing (not deleted — low risk, prefixed TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Topic→Variable mapping feature is production-ready. The two prod mappings (/A100/TEMPERATURA, /A100/VAG → A100) persist in db.topic_mappings and route CJ031 traffic correctly. If any future test needs to validate routing, use GET /api/admin/mqtt/sniff/A100 and look for events with ev['mapped_from']==topic. If creating viewer accounts for 403 tests, POST /api/users (NOT /api/admin/users).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature test, not a bug fix.
